function.name: executeTx
function.description: Execute a single on-chain transaction (state-changing): a native ETH transfer or an ERC-20 transfer. One call per transaction. Do NOT use this for swaps — swaps use the dedicated swap tool and never need a separate approval here.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

to.description: Target contract address (0x) the call is sent to. For an ERC-20 transfer/approve this is the token contract; for a native transfer this is the recipient.

value.description: Native value in wei as a decimal string. "0" for contract calls; the amount in wei for a native transfer.

function.description: Function signature being called, e.g. "transfer(address,uint256)". Null for a plain native transfer with no calldata.

args.description: Positional arguments matching the function signature, in order. Tuple parameters are nested arrays. Empty for a native transfer.

function.name: readTx
function.description: Read state from the chain (read-only call, no value transfer).

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

to.description: Target contract address (0x) the call is sent to. For an ERC-20 transfer/approve this is the token contract; for a native transfer this is the recipient.

function.description: Function signature being called, e.g. "transfer(address,uint256)". Null for a plain native transfer with no calldata.

args.description: Positional arguments matching the function signature, in order. Tuple parameters are nested arrays. Empty for a native transfer.

function.name: shield
function.description: Deposit ETH into the user's RAILGUN shielded (private) pool. Use this whenever the user expresses intent to shield, make private, deposit into privacy, or hide funds. Shielding is a public on-chain deposit signed by the user's own account.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

amount.description: Amount of ETH to shield, in HUMAN units as a decimal string (e.g. "0.01"). Do NOT convert to wei.

token.description: Token to shield. Only ETH is supported; default to ETH.

function.name: unshield
function.description: Withdraw ETH from the user's RAILGUN shielded (private) pool to a recipient as native ETH. Use this whenever the user expresses intent to unshield, withdraw from privacy, or make funds public again. The withdrawal is relayed by the wallet's own local broadcaster.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

amount.description: Amount of ETH to unshield, in HUMAN units as a decimal string (e.g. "0.01"). Do NOT convert to wei.

to.description: Recipient, as a 0x-prefixed 40-hex Ethereum address. ENS names and contact names are NOT yet supported for unshield — if the user gives one, ask them for the 0x address instead of calling this tool.

token.description: Token to unshield. Only ETH is supported; default to ETH.

function.name: transfer
function.description: Send native ETH or an ERC-20 token from the user's smart account to a recipient. Use this whenever the user expresses intent to send, transfer, pay, or move tokens to an address, an ENS name (*.eth), or a saved contact name. If the recipient or amount is missing or ambiguous, ask a clarifying question in natural language instead of calling the tool.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

to.description: Recipient. Accepts a 0x-prefixed 40-hex Ethereum address, an ENS name ending in .eth, or a contact name the user mentioned. Pass the value as the user expressed it - do not attempt to resolve ENS yourself.

amount.description: Amount in human units as a decimal string (e.g. "0.1", "100.5"). Do not include the token symbol here. Use the literal string "all" if the user clearly intends to send their entire balance.

token.description: Token symbol such as ETH, USDC, DAI, WETH, or a 0x-prefixed contract address. Default to ETH if the user does not name a token.

function.name: swap
function.description: Swap one token for another from the user's smart account. Use this whenever the user expresses intent to swap, convert, trade, or exchange one token for another.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id as a decimal string, e.g. "1" for Ethereum mainnet.

from_token.description: Token to spend. Symbol (ETH, USDC, DAI, WETH) or 0x-prefixed contract address.

to_token.description: Token to receive. Symbol (ETH, USDC, DAI, WETH) or 0x-prefixed contract address.

amount.description: Exact input amount to spend as a decimal string in human units. Do not use this tool when the user specifies only the desired output amount.

amount_side.description: Always "input". Only exact-input swaps are supported.
